text:
Oliver: quick design pass on Compliance > Keys panel  a few small UX/a11y nits I noticed while testing the console. want to triage.
Tina: sure, list them out.
Oliver: 1) KMS label currently shows full ARN inline and wraps on tablet -> visual noise. 2) audit timeline rows dump full ARNs + ISO timestamps, hard to scan. 3) on narrow widths the region picker is visually separated from the encryption toggle so users miss the association. 4) retention CTA text is ambiguous. 5) screen reader reads the entire ARN for the toggle aria-label.
Sam: agreed on 1 + 2. current primary label is basically `arn:aws:kms:...`. suggestion: visible headline = `Customer key (CMK)`; secondary muted line = `key-0a1b...` only when expanded.
Priya: timeline copy: instead of `2026-03-12 09:42:11 - key applied: arn:... user=alice` propose `09:42 UTC  Customer key used by alice (key-0a1b)` with expand for full details (ARN, request id). use past-tense verbs.
Tina: layout tweak for small view: stack as Region > Retention > Encryption toggle so the toggle remains above the fold. keeps CTA visible on phones.
Oliver: accessibility: toggle currently uses aria-label that concatenates the ARN. change to aria-describedby -> point to the short headline element; expose full ARN only in the details panel and via a `View key details` button. also add a tooltip `View key details` and a small copy icon next to truncated id.
Sam: small copy nit: swap `Set retention` -> `Change retention period`. clearer for users editing a numeric value.
Priya: sounds good. i can draft the copy updates and a tiny Figma frame showing the stacked narrow layout.
Tina: ping @a11y for quick signoff on aria pattern?
a11y-bot: tagging @a11y team for review. Recommended pattern: short visible label + aria-describedby for control; full id in expanded region with accessible focus target.
issue-bot: created INF-9333 "Compact KMS label + timeline readability + aria fix" (priority: P3).
Oliver: perfect. Sam, can you open a small PR with the copy + layout notes and tag design + a11y?
Sam: will do, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
